generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A schema-valid evidence package can retain every required field while replacing discriminant semantics with generic filler and one coarse green gate, making unrelated risk families appear saturated without scenario proof.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Generate negative controls from a template whose failure, procedure, expected and observed fields are generic, then reuse one aggregate CI summary as evidence for every attack surface.
trigger_signals: shared evidence file across risk families

reusable_control.requirement: Reject semantic placeholders and require every material control to identify a discriminant attack plus scenario-specific executable provenance.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: When regenerating an adversarial matrix, preserve or improve the semantic specificity of each control; never replace scenario descriptions with generic filler merely to satisfy schema shape.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Fail readiness when mandatory adversarial fields normalize to known placeholder phrases or when a material control cannot be traced to an executable source that exercises its declared dimension.

transfer_cases.scenario: Distinguish provider acceptance, confirmed delivery and failure with separate observed assertions instead of a global test-suite pass.
Bind cross-tenant denial to a boundary/full-stack source proving the foreign context is denied before protected state is exposed or mutated.

skill_changes.change: The producer contract requires discriminant negative controls and scenario-specific provenance rather than generic green-gate assertions.
The validator rejects known placeholder phrases and regression coverage reproduces the escaped package shape.
